form.label: Network Assurance & Service Health
form.description: From reactive troubleshooting to proactive assurance: every row pairs a network leading indicator (Cisco Catalyst Center, Meraki, ThousandEyes) with the business impact it predicts (AI Support Bot and hotline, collaboration, B2B transactions).

panel.title: AI Support Bot – path to DC Frankfurt

single.title: Leading: packet loss to DC Frankfurt

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent thousandeyes.target.agent.location=frankfurt | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 1)

single.title: Impact: calls waiting in the Support Hotline

search.query: index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline" | stats latest(calls_waiting) as waiting

single.title: Leading: packet loss on DC paths

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent "thousandeyes.test.name"="*Berlin*" NOT "thousandeyes.test.name"="* to Frankfurt" | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as loss | eval loss=round(loss, 2)
index=demo_tomcat_logs host=berweb* 504 | rex field=_raw "\" (?<http_status>\d{3}) " | stats count(eval(http_status="504")) as timeouts
index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=bgp thousandeyes.agent.location=atlanta | stats latest(metric_name:bgp.reachability) as reach

index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=web-transaction thousandeyes.agent.location=atlanta | stats avg(metric_name:web.transaction.completion) as completion | eval completion=round(completion, 0)

panel.title: Service health by site and domain (last 5 minutes)

search.query: index=demo_cisco_catalyst sourcetype="cisco:dnac:devicehealth" earliest=-5m | eval site=lower(mvindex(split(Location, "/"), -1)) | stats avg(HealthScore) as campus by site | append [search index=demo_cisco_meraki sourcetype="meraki:assurancealerts" categoryType=connectivity earliest=-15m | eval site=lower(mvindex(split('network.name', "-"), 0)) | stats count as wan_alerts by site] | append [search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent earliest=-5m | eval site=mvappend('thousandeyes.agent.location', 'thousandeyes.target.agent.location') | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as dc_loss by site] | append [search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=bgp earliest=-10m | eval site='thousandeyes.agent.location' | stats latest(metric_name:bgp.reachability) as bgp by site] | append [search index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=http-server earliest=-5m | eval site='thousandeyes.agent.location' | stats avg(metric_name:http.server.request.availability) as saas by site] | append [search index=demo_msteams event_type=call_ended earliest=-10m | eval site=location | stats avg(packet_loss_pct) as teams_loss by site] | append [search index=demo_mes production_rate_per_hour=* ai_inspection_mode=* earliest=-5m | eval site=location | stats avg(eval(if(ai_inspection_mode="inline", 100, 0))) as ai by site] | stats first(*) as * by site | fillnull value=0 wan_alerts | eval campus=round(campus, 1), dc_loss=round(dc_loss, 2), saas=round(saas, 1), teams_loss=round(teams_loss, 2), ai=round(ai, 0) | eval site=upper(substr(site, 1, 1)) . substr(site, 2) | table site campus wan_alerts dc_loss bgp saas teams_loss ai | rename site as Site, campus as "Campus health (Catalyst)", wan_alerts as "WAN alerts 15m (Meraki)", dc_loss as "DC path loss % (TE)", bgp as "BGP reachability % (TE)", saas as "SaaS availability % (TE)", teams_loss as "Teams media loss %", ai as "AI inspection inline %"

panel.title: DC Frankfurt: leading indicator vs. impact

search.query: (index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent thousandeyes.target.agent.location=frankfurt) OR (index=demo_msteams event_type=call_queue_stats queue_name="Support Hotline") | timechart span=1m avg(metric_name:network.loss) as "Loss % to DC Frankfurt (leading)" max(calls_waiting) as "Hotline calls waiting (impact)"

panel.title: Berlin WAN: leading indicator vs. impact

search.query: (index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent "thousandeyes.test.name"="*Berlin*" NOT "thousandeyes.test.name"="* to Frankfurt") OR (index=demo_tomcat_logs host=berweb* 504) | rex field=_raw "\" (?<http_status>\d{3}) " | eval timeout=if(index="demo_tomcat_logs" AND http_status="504", 1, null()) | timechart span=1m avg(metric_name:network.loss) as "DC path loss % (leading)" count(timeout) as "HTTP 504 Berlin (impact)"

panel.title: Atlanta internet path: leading indicator vs. impact

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.agent.location=atlanta thousandeyes.test.type IN ("bgp", "web-transaction") | timechart span=1m min(metric_name:bgp.reachability) as "BGP reachability % (leading)" avg(metric_name:web.transaction.completion) as "B2B order completion % (impact)"

index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=agent-to-agent | stats avg(metric_name:network.loss) as loss avg(metric_name:network.latency) as latency avg(metric_name:network.jitter) as jitter by thousandeyes.test.name | eval loss=round(loss, 2), latency=round(latency * 1000, 0), jitter=round(jitter, 1) | rename thousandeyes.test.name as Path, loss as "Loss %", latency as "Latency ms", jitter as "Jitter ms"

panel.title: ThousandEyes BGP – AS path per vantage point

search.query: index=demo_thousendeyes thousandeyes.test.type=bgp | stats latest(bgp.prefix) as Prefix latest(bgp.as_path) as "AS path" latest(metric_name:bgp.reachability) as "Reachability %" sum(metric_name:bgp.path_changes.count) as "Path changes" sum(metric_name:bgp.updates.count) as Updates by thousandeyes.agent.location | rename thousandeyes.agent.location as "Vantage point"

html.p: Deep dives: AI Workload Infrastructure · Catalyst Center · Meraki · ThousandEyes · Manufacturing · Network & Collaboration · Tomcat
